title: There Is and There Are
introduction: Describe what can be found in a place.
definition: Describe what can be found in a place.
rules: Use there is for one thing and there are for more than one.
Use Is there ...? or Are there ...? to ask about things.

exercises.question: ___ there a garden?
exercises.solution: Use Is there for one place or thing.

exercises.question: ___ there two beds?
exercises.solution: Use Are there for plural things.

exercises.question: There ___ not a table. (is or are)
exercises.solution: A table is singular, even in a negative sentence.

summary: Describe what can be found in a place. Use there is for one thing and there are for more than one.
